rows.en: Right, I'll get to work on it right away.
The other parts are already finished, but I'll need you to wait a little longer.
Gundam, Kamen Rider, Ultraman... The heroes of every world pooled their knowledge and skills...
and the work went on day and night.
And then...
It's done!
Yes. This is the fruit of everyone's cooperation.
Now that's impressive!
It's quite different from the Ptolemaios.
Yeah. We only used its internal structure as a base.
For everything else, we adapted all kinds of different technologies.
And this time the weapons are insane, too! No way we can lose now, right?
With this, we can strike at the enemy's base.
About that... I talked it over with Hikari and everyone else,
I talked it over with Hikari and our comrades,
and for the assault on their base, we'd like the Hero Team to be the strike force.
Given our forces, we judged that gives us the best odds of winning.
Of course, we'll give you solid support from the rear.
Understood. We'll take it on.
After all, we've got Wing Zero and 00 with us now.
Leave it to us!! We'll pull it off better than you guys, just watch!
We'll pull it off better than you guys, just watch!
Good to hear you say that. It's reassuring.
Still, you'd be stuck if we just told you to run the Ride Machine out of nowhere,
so Seravee's going with you too.
After all, I know the Ride Machine better than anyone.
That's a big help.
Right, let me fill you in on what we know about the enemy so far.
Seems they've gained the power of yet another world. They say that power creates "miracles."
They say it creates "the power of miracles."
That's hard to believe.
But if it's true, we've got to stop them before they can use it.
And one more thing... It's about this Cube's boss.
It's about this Cube's boss.
We knew the enemy's goal was the research and development of new weapons.
Going by that, we had assumed the boss here was the scientist type... In other words...
an enemy without much need for combat strength. We jumped to that conclusion on our own...
But when we learned the boss's true identity, we were stunned.
Firepower, armor, mobility... The enemy is a mobile suit that's overwhelming in all of them.
Its name is "The O."
The O!?
...The O, huh. That's one troublesome enemy.
You know it?
The O... So that guy's behind this Cube...
The O... He sets himself up as a mere bystander and thinks war is nothing but a game!
That's probably why he hasn't shown himself until now, too.
I see. He keeps his own hands clean and watches the pawns he raised fight from on high, huh?
Unforgivable... He deserves to die ten thousand deaths.
It also worries me that The O is trying to use that power to create "miracles."
Yes. Let's stop him with everything we've got.
All right! When you guys storm their stronghold, we'll pull off a perfect diversion for ya!
So don't worry, just charge right in!
Deathscythe, there are still areas we have to take control of, you know?
Of course I know. That's exactly why a diversion will work.
I see! The more areas we might take, the harder it is for the enemy to predict our moves...
Exactly.
Then we can focus solely on taking their base, too.
...So, without further ado, I'd like to get used to the Ride Machine... no, the {806C}.
Well then, time we moved the Ride Machine to the Ride Gate.
Let's move it to the Ride Gate right away.
I'll have it ready so you can board it as soon as you get there.
I'm coming with you too, so I'll teach you anything you don't know.
Head to the Ride Gate in the "Quicksand Zone."
Oi, you lot!! Ain't you forgettin' somethin'!?
What's up, Den-O... Ah, right, you're Momotaros right now.
The name!! N-A-M-E!! You went and built a cool machine, didn't ya!?
What're you doin' not givin' it a name!?
What's wrong with "Ride Machine"?
...Figured it'd be somethin' like that. So I went and thought up a few for ya, see!?
Now, you lot! Pick one, and be grateful!!
＜ｒｉｄｅ＿ｎａｍｅ, huh?
You picked this one? You've got some real taste!! ...Truth is, this was the one I was proudest of.
Right, from now on, you're all gonna call the Ride Machine "{806C}"!!
Uh, y-yeah...
...What? You don't like it?
It's wonderful!! I can feel my heart burning up!!
The secured route to Area 3 is up ahead.
This is Operation Area A. The objective is to recover the "Emerium ore"...
Its location has been confirmed in the deepest part of this area. Sneak in and recover it.

notes.note: No speaker label; continues Hikari's line 0230.44 (all materials gathered), so Hikari speaking to the party. #0.46 likewise Hikari.
Silent '...' with no speaker; left as a bare ellipsis (party reaction before the narration).
Narration; #0.48-#0.49 are one sentence cut across two rows, cut at the same point.
Hondenchi rendered 'base' as in earlier slices ('attack their base'); #0.97's honmaru (inner keep) rendered 'stronghold'.
#0.61, #0.68, #0.76, #0.80, #0.106 are shorter alternate versions of the neighbouring line, translated to match it. #0.60-#0.62 read as one sentence.
Zero's 'makasetoke' rendered 'Leave it to us' (he is answering for the strike team); the trailing '?' is a cocky 'just watch', not a real question.
#0.70-#0.71 one sentence cut across two rows.
#0.84 has no speaker label; Seravee continuing. Sentence cut across #0.82/#0.83 at the matching point.
Zeta's 'yatsu' rendered 'that guy'; The O is male per glossary (Scirocco).
Tieria's signature 'banshi ni atai suru' kept at full strength: 'He deserves to die ten thousand deaths.'

No speakers for #0.99-#0.104. Inferred: #0.99/#0.101 Sandrock (calls Duo 'Deathscythe', uses 'boku'), #0.100/#0.102 Deathscythe Hell, #0.103/#0.104 a Hero Team member (likely Nu Gundam, who accepted the strike role). No line needs a gendered pronoun.

Source kanji for 'get used to' appears mis-encoded (reads as 'resent'); taken as 'nareru' = get used to. {806C} = player-chosen Ride Machine name; padding dropped. The line references the chosen name although it is indexed before the naming scene (#0.122-#0.125); probably played after naming.
No speaker; 'boku' + 'I'm coming with you' matches Seravee being assigned to go along (#0.71-#0.72).
System directive; 'Quicksand Zone' as in story_025.

#0.114-#0.128 no speaker labels. Momotaros (Den-O Sword Form) speaks #0.114, #0.116-#0.117, #0.119-#0.120, #0.124-#0.125, #0.127 (#0.115 names him). #0.115, #0.118, #0.126 are unidentified party members; #0.128 polite and earnest (possibly Mebius) - kept neutral.

Source is a full-width placeholder '<ride_name' (likely a dev stub for the chosen-name prompt) followed by 'da na?' and a trailing line break. Placeholder kept exactly as written; only the Japanese part translated; trailing line break kept.
{806C} name variable inside quotes; padding dropped.
Maganac line looks mis-encoded: two kanji read as 'kakuma' and 'waza' make no sense; guessed as 'kakuho ruuto wa kono saki desu' = 'The secured route to Area 3 is up ahead.' Uncertain.
Sakusen kuiki A rendered 'Operation Area A'; Emerium ore per glossary, quotes kept as in source.

report: 80/80 rows. Many unlabelled rows: speakers inferred (Hikari #0.45-46, Seravee #0.84/#0.108, Sandrock/Deathscythe Hell #0.99-102, Momotaros naming scene #0.114-127). Uncertain: 0231.1 mis-encoded kanji guessed ('secured route... up ahead'); #0.104 mis-encoded 'get used to' and references the machine name before the naming scene; #0.122 full-width '<ride_name' placeholder kept; #0.128 speaker unknown. Not in glossary: Quicksand Zone (from story_025), Operation Area A.
